question: Which of the following folk dances belongs to the tribes of the Jharkhand state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mundari dance.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mundari dance belongs to the tribes of the Jharkhand state.
 
• Munda tribe have its own dance which performed during harvest season and festival accompanied by musical Instrument Madal, Nagara, and Bansi.
 
• Munda refers to their dance and song as Durang and Susun respectively Mundari folk dance are Jadur and Jena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Huttari dance** is also known as the Kodagu dance.

 
 
• It is one of the most spirited dances of Karnataka.
 
 
 
• **Nati **is native to the states of Himachal Pradesh and Uttrakhand.
 
• **Bhavai** is a genre of folk dance popular in Gujarat state in western India.
